name: Capsule bloom
rationale: Eight short rounded capsules turn the radial strokes into soft petals while keeping the pupil and almond immediately legible.
tradeoff: The repeated petals may feel more floral or animated than a quiet iris.

name: Eight circle iris
rationale: Eight separate circles make the company motif explicit and keep the iris construction simple at small sizes.
tradeoff: The dot ring is less distinctive than radial petals and can read as an aperture.

name: Soft directional almond
rationale: A rounder right lid gives the almond a gentle forward lean, with the eight circle iris shifted just enough to suggest attention moving outward.
tradeoff: The softened right corner reduces the crispness of the eye silhouette.

name: Cutout gaze
rationale: A solid almond rim carved around a clear aperture makes a bolder app mark while the offset eight circle iris preserves the forward gaze.
tradeoff: The heavier rim can dominate the small iris beside Comfortaa.
